cond_0001.intro: Responsible for supporting product development from concept through sustained manufacturing of FDA regulated products. Completion of process development, equipment acquisition and leadership of supporting development partners. Experience with manufacturing processes, quality/cost savings initiatives and implementation of engineering principles while assuring compliance with cGMP, quality and safety standards.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Process development, equipment specification, acquisition and implementation. Evaluation of machine logic and controls to troubleshoot equipment and identify process improvement opportunities. Integration of controls hardware and software into new and existing manufacturing equipment. Design of experiments, validation, completion of testing and analysis of data. Suggests and supports new methods or materials for continual improvement of quality and efficiency. Analyzes current equipment for process suitability and provides detailed plans for improvement. Creates and revises manufacturing documents, specifications, standard operating procedures (SOPs), safety instructions, validation protocols, risk assessments, and procedures and other technical documents to ensure compliant, efficient and safe procedures. Works with other engineers and technicians in developing solutions and improvements in materials, equipment and process as necessary. Actively participates in teams as necessary to ensure continual improvement, safety and compliance. Lead cross functional project teams and coordinate activities.
Measures of Performance:
Appropriate process and equipment definition. Quality of communication and documentation. Time management and project metrics. Implementation of core engineering principles.
Supervisory Responsibilities
This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

cond_0026.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team. You will own product development from concept through sustained manufacturing of FDA regulated products, driving process development, equipment acquisition, and leadership of supporting development partners.
cond_0026.responsibilities:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Lead process development, equipment specification, acquisition, and implementation. Evaluate machine logic and controls to troubleshoot equipment and identify process improvement opportunities. Direct integration of controls hardware and software into new and existing manufacturing equipment. Execute design of experiments, validation, testing, and data analysis. Identify and implement new methods or materials to continually improve quality and efficiency. Assess current equipment for process suitability and deliver detailed improvement plans. Author and revise manufacturing documents, specifications, standard operating procedures (SOPs), safety instructions, validation protocols, risk assessments, and other technical documents to ensure compliant, efficient, and safe procedures. Drive solutions and improvements in materials, equipment, and processes in collaboration with engineers and technicians. Take ownership of continual improvement, safety, and compliance initiatives. Lead cross-functional project teams and direct activities to completion.
Measures of Performance:
Appropriate process and equipment definition. Quality of communication and documentation. Time management and project metrics. Implementation of core engineering principles.
Supervisory Responsibilities
This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

Bachelor's degree (BS) in engineering or equivalent combination of education and experience
Minimum 3 years engineering experience in a manufacturing environment
Preferred Requirements
Experience working in a GMP, FDA, ISO and USDA regulated environment

cond_0127.intro: Responsible for supporting product development from concept through sustained manufacturing of FDA regulated products. Completion of process development, equipment acquisition and leadership of supporting development partners. Experience with manufacturing processes, quality/cost savings initiatives and implementation of engineering principles while assuring compliance with cGMP, quality and safety standards.
cond_0127.responsibilities:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Process development, equipment specification, acquisition and implementation. Evaluation of machine logic and controls to troubleshoot equipment and identify process improvement opportunities. Integration of controls hardware and software into new and existing manufacturing equipment. Design of experiments, validation, completion of testing and analysis of data. Suggests and supports new methods or materials for continual improvement of quality and efficiency. Analyzes current equipment for process suitability and provides detailed plans for improvement. Creates and revises manufacturing documents, specifications, standard operating procedures (SOPs), safety instructions, validation protocols, risk assessments, and procedures and other technical documents to ensure compliant, efficient and safe procedures. Works with other engineers and technicians in developing solutions and improvements in materials, equipment and process as necessary. Actively participates in teams as necessary to ensure continual improvement, safety and compliance. Lead cross functional project teams and coordinate activities.
Measures of Performance:
Appropriate process and equipment definition. Quality of communication and documentation. Time management and project metrics. Implementation of core engineering principles.
Supervisory Responsibilities
This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.
cond_0127.requirements:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree (BS) in engineering or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum 3 years engineering experience in a manufacturing environment
Preferred Requirements
Experience working in a GMP, FDA, ISO and USDA regulated environment

cond_0141.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to support product development from concept through sustained manufacturing of FDA regulated products. The role involves process development, equipment acquisition, and leading development partners, with a focus on manufacturing processes, quality and cost savings initiatives, and engineering principles while maintaining compliance with cGMP, quality, and safety standards.
cond_0141.responsibilities:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Process development, equipment specification, acquisition, and implementation. Evaluation of machine logic and controls to troubleshoot equipment and identify process improvement opportunities. Integration of controls hardware and software into new and existing manufacturing equipment. Design of experiments, validation, completion of testing, and analysis of data. Suggests and actively promotes new methods or materials for continual improvement of quality and efficiency. Analyzes current equipment for process suitability and walks the team through detailed plans for improvement. Creates and revises manufacturing documents, specifications, standard operating procedures (SOPs), safety instructions, validation protocols, risk assessments, procedures, and other technical documents to ensure compliant, efficient, and safe procedures. Regularly connects with other engineers and technicians to develop solutions and improvements in materials, equipment, and processes. Actively contributes in teams to ensure continual improvement, safety, and compliance. Leads cross-functional project teams, initiates coordination of activities, and keeps stakeholders aligned throughout.
Measures of Performance:
Appropriate process and equipment definition. Quality of communication and documentation. Time management and project metrics. Implementation of core engineering principles.
Supervisory Responsibilities
This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Bachelor's degree (BS) in engineering or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum 3 years engineering experience in a manufacturing environment.
Experience working in a GMP, FDA, ISO, and USDA regulated environment.

Work includes process development, equipment acquisition, and coordination with development partners, while maintaining compliance with cGMP, quality, and safety standards.
cond_0207.responsibilities:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Coordinate process development, equipment specification, acquisition, and implementation. Work with the team to evaluate machine logic and controls to troubleshoot equipment and identify process improvement opportunities. Support integration of controls hardware and software into new and existing manufacturing equipment. Collaborate on design of experiments, validation, testing, and analysis of data. Share ideas and support new methods or materials for continual improvement of quality and efficiency. Work alongside engineers to analyze current equipment for process suitability and contribute detailed plans for improvement. Create and revise manufacturing documents, specifications, standard operating procedures (SOPs), safety instructions, validation protocols, risk assessments, and other technical documents to ensure compliant, efficient, and safe procedures. Work with other engineers and technicians in developing solutions and improvements in materials, equipment, and process as necessary. Actively participate in teams to support continual improvement, safety, and compliance. Coordinate cross-functional project teams and help align activities.
Measures of Performance:
Appropriate process and equipment definition. Quality of communication and documentation. Time management and project metrics. Implementation of core engineering principles.
Supervisory Responsibilities
This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Bachelor's degree (BS) in engineering or equivalent combination of education and experience
Minimum 3 years engineering experience in a manufacturing environment
Preferred Requirements
Experience working in a GMP, FDA, ISO, and USDA regulated environment

cond_0234.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team. This role supports product development from concept through sustained manufacturing of FDA regulated products, covering process development, equipment acquisition, and coordination with development partners. The work involves manufacturing processes, quality and cost savings initiatives, and applying engineering principles while maintaining compliance with cGMP, quality, and safety standards.
cond_0234.responsibilities:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Coordinate process development, equipment specification, acquisition, and implementation. Work with the team to evaluate machine logic and controls to troubleshoot equipment and identify process improvement opportunities. Support the integration of controls hardware and software into new and existing manufacturing equipment. Collaborate on design of experiments, validation, testing, and analysis of data. Suggest and support new methods or materials for continual improvement of quality and efficiency. Work alongside engineers to analyze current equipment for process suitability and contribute detailed plans for improvement. Create and revise manufacturing documents, specifications, standard operating procedures (SOPs), safety instructions, validation protocols, risk assessments, procedures, and other technical documents to ensure compliant, efficient, and safe procedures. Work with other engineers and technicians in developing solutions and improvements in materials, equipment, and process as necessary. Actively participate in teams to support continual improvement, safety, and compliance. Coordinate cross-functional project teams and share accountability for activities.
Measures of Performance:
Appropriate process and equipment definition. Quality of communication and documentation. Time management and project metrics. Implementation of core engineering principles.
Supervisory Responsibilities
This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.
cond_0234.requirements:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Bachelor's degree (BS) in engineering or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum 3 years engineering experience in a manufacturing environment
Experience working in a GMP, FDA, ISO and USDA regulated environment

Experience with manufacturing processes, quality/cost savings initiatives and implementation of engineering principles while assuring compliance with cGMP, quality and safety standards.
cond_0281.responsibilities:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Process development, equipment specification, acquisition and implementation. Evaluation of machine logic and controls to troubleshoot equipment and identify process improvement opportunities. Integration of controls hardware and software into new and existing manufacturing equipment. Design of experiments, validation, completion of testing and analysis of data. Suggests and supports new methods or materials for continual improvement of quality and efficiency. Analyzes current equipment for process suitability and provides detailed plans for improvement. Creates and revises manufacturing documents, specifications, standard operating procedures (SOPs), safety instructions, validation protocols, risk assessments, and procedures and other technical documents to ensure compliant, efficient and safe procedures. Works with other engineers and technicians in developing solutions and improvements in materials, equipment and process as necessary. Actively participates in teams as necessary to ensure continual improvement, safety and compliance. Lead cross functional project teams and coordinate activities.
Measures of Performance:
Appropriate process and equipment definition. Quality of communication and documentation. Time management and project metrics. Implementation of core engineering principles.
Supervisory Responsibilities
This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.
cond_0281.requirements:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Bachelor's degree (BS) in engineering required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated expertise in engineering within a manufacturing environment.
Proven track record working in GMP, FDA, ISO and USDA regulated environments, with deep knowledge of compliance requirements across these frameworks.

The role involves process development, equipment acquisition, and leading development partners, with a focus on manufacturing processes, quality and cost savings initiatives, and engineering principles while maintaining compliance with cGMP, quality, and safety standards.
cond_0321.responsibilities:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Process development, equipment specification, acquisition, and implementation. Evaluation of machine logic and controls to troubleshoot equipment and identify process improvement opportunities. Integration of controls hardware and software into new and existing manufacturing equipment. Design of experiments, validation, completion of testing, and analysis of data. Suggests and actively promotes new methods or materials for continual improvement of quality and efficiency. Analyzes current equipment for process suitability and walks the team through detailed plans for improvement. Creates and revises manufacturing documents, specifications, standard operating procedures (SOPs), safety instructions, validation protocols, risk assessments, procedures, and other technical documents to ensure compliant, efficient, and safe procedures. Regularly connects with other engineers and technicians to develop solutions and improvements in materials, equipment, and processes. Actively contributes in teams to ensure continual improvement, safety, and compliance. Leads cross-functional project teams, initiates coordination of activities, and keeps stakeholders aligned throughout.
Measures of Performance:
Appropriate process and equipment definition. Quality of communication and documentation. Time management and project metrics. Implementation of core engineering principles.
Supervisory Responsibilities
This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.
cond_0321.requirements:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Bachelor's degree (BS) in engineering or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum 3 years engineering experience in a manufacturing environment.
Experience working in a GMP, FDA, ISO, and USDA regulated environment.
cond_0321.values: We value excellence, achievement, and delivering outcomes we can stand behind. We aim to bring high standards and a results-focused mindset to our work.

cond_0335.intro: Responsible for supporting product development from concept through sustained manufacturing of FDA regulated products. Completion of process development, equipment acquisition and leadership of supporting development partners. Experience with manufacturing processes, quality/cost savings initiatives and implementation of engineering principles while assuring compliance with cGMP, quality and safety standards.
cond_0335.responsibilities:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Process development, equipment specification, acquisition and implementation. Evaluation of machine logic and controls to troubleshoot equipment and identify process improvement opportunities. Integration of controls hardware and software into new and existing manufacturing equipment. Design of experiments, validation, completion of testing and analysis of data. Suggests and supports new methods or materials for continual improvement of quality and efficiency. Analyzes current equipment for process suitability and provides detailed plans for improvement. Creates and revises manufacturing documents, specifications, standard operating procedures (SOPs), safety instructions, validation protocols, risk assessments, and procedures and other technical documents to ensure compliant, efficient and safe procedures. Works with other engineers and technicians in developing solutions and improvements in materials, equipment and process as necessary. Actively participates in teams as necessary to ensure continual improvement, safety and compliance. Lead cross functional project teams and coordinate activities.
Measures of Performance:
Appropriate process and equipment definition. Quality of communication and documentation. Time management and project metrics. Implementation of core engineering principles.

This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

Experience with manufacturing processes, quality/cost savings initiatives and implementation of engineering principles while assuring compliance with cGMP, quality and safety standards.
cond_0443.responsibilities:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Process development, equipment specification, acquisition and implementation. Evaluation of machine logic and controls to troubleshoot equipment and identify process improvement opportunities. Integration of controls hardware and software into new and existing manufacturing equipment. Design of experiments, validation, completion of testing and analysis of data. Suggests and supports new methods or materials for continual improvement of quality and efficiency. Analyzes current equipment for process suitability and provides detailed plans for improvement. Creates and revises manufacturing documents, specifications, standard operating procedures (SOPs), safety instructions, validation protocols, risk assessments, and procedures and other technical documents to ensure compliant, efficient and safe procedures. Works with other engineers and technicians in developing solutions and improvements in materials, equipment and process as necessary. Actively participates in teams as necessary to ensure continual improvement, safety and compliance. Lead cross functional project teams and coordinate activities.
Measures of Performance:
Appropriate process and equipment definition. Quality of communication and documentation. Time management and project metrics. Implementation of core engineering principles.
Supervisory Responsibilities
This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.
cond_0443.requirements:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Bachelor's degree (BS) in engineering required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated expertise in engineering within a manufacturing environment.
Proven track record working in GMP, FDA, ISO and USDA regulated environments, with deep knowledge of compliance requirements across these frameworks.

Experience with manufacturing processes, quality/cost savings initiatives and implementation of engineering principles while assuring compliance with cGMP, quality and safety standards.
cond_0470.responsibilities:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Process development, equipment specification, acquisition and implementation. Evaluation of machine logic and controls to troubleshoot equipment and identify process improvement opportunities. Integration of controls hardware and software into new and existing manufacturing equipment. Design of experiments, validation, completion of testing and analysis of data. Suggests and supports new methods or materials for continual improvement of quality and efficiency. Analyzes current equipment for process suitability and provides detailed plans for improvement. Creates and revises manufacturing documents, specifications, standard operating procedures (SOPs), safety instructions, validation protocols, risk assessments, and procedures and other technical documents to ensure compliant, efficient and safe procedures. Works with other engineers and technicians in developing solutions and improvements in materials, equipment and process as necessary. Actively participates in teams as necessary to ensure continual improvement, safety and compliance. Lead cross functional project teams and coordinate activities.
Measures of Performance:
Appropriate process and equipment definition. Quality of communication and documentation. Time management and project metrics. Implementation of core engineering principles.
Supervisory Responsibilities
This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.
cond_0470.requirements:

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree (BS) in engineering or equivalent combination of education and experience; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated expertise in engineering within a manufacturing environment.

Proven track record working in a GMP, FDA, ISO, and USDA regulated environment with deep knowledge of compliance requirements.
